name: Troll Necklace Bounty
summary: At Aerie Peak, Fraggar Thundermantle asks you to bring him five necklaces from trolls in the Hinterlands.

sections.title: Earning Wildhammer Regard
sections.body: Fraggar Thundermantle trusts deeds over words. The Wildhammers answer to no Alliance, and anyone seeking their friendship must prove their worth first. Trolls roaming the Hinterlands hillsides sometimes wear tribal necklaces. Bring five to Fraggar at Aerie Peak, and you will have made a start.

faq.q: Why does Fraggar Thundermantle want troll necklaces?
faq.answer: Fraggar judges people by their deeds, not their words. Five troll necklaces make a good beginning for anyone seeking Wildhammer friendship.

faq.q: Are the Wildhammers part of the Alliance?
faq.answer: Fraggar says the Wildhammers are independent and answer to no Alliance. They judge people by their deeds.

faq.q: Where can troll tribal necklaces be found?
aliases: where to get troll tribal necklace
faq.answer: Trolls roaming the Hinterlands hillsides sometimes carry tribal necklaces.

faq.q: Who do I return the necklaces to?
faq.answer: Bring the five necklaces to Fraggar Thundermantle at Aerie Peak.
